concerns.text: SC-005 (computational feasibility) requires a measurable time‑limit and memory‑constraint check, but no task in the list records or validates these metrics (e.g., a task that logs runtime/memory usage and asserts they meet the defined thresholds).

The data‑model document (data-model.md) defines core entities (e.g., MaterialCompound, DescriptorSet, ModelResult) yet there is no task explicitly dedicated to creating, validating, or version‑controlling these entities (such as schema generation or data‑model implementation tasks).
